field.label: API Key
field.comment: Paste the key issued when you add this store at horizon.byte8.io (shown once; rotate it from the dashboard if lost). Stored encrypted and shown masked; leave the mask untouched to keep the current key. Requests must include header: X-Horizon-Key: your-api-key

field.label: Gateway URL
field.comment: Base URL of the Byte8 Horizon gateway. Defaults to https://horizon.byte8.io; include the scheme. Used for catalog invalidation webhooks and the AI assistant bootstrap. Point it at a local gateway (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8085) for development, or clear it to disable outbound webhooks.

field.label: Write Key
field.comment: Optional. Issued under Agent write access on the store's page in the Horizon dashboard (shown once). Only this key can call the /horizon/api/v1/admin/* endpoints that change the store; the API Key above stays read-only even if it leaks. Leave empty to keep the store read-only.

field.label: Write Scopes
field.comment: What the write key may change. Enforced here, in the extension, on every write; the dashboard's own scope list only decides which tools agents see. Every write supports a dry run and is recorded in the dashboard's Changes list.

group.label: Agent Writes
group.comment: Limits for the catalog:write scope. Every product write is previewed as a change set before it is applied and listed under Changes in the Horizon dashboard.

field.label: Writable Product Attributes
field.comment: Attribute codes an agent may set under attributes (one per line or comma separated), e.g. color, size, manufacturer, country_of_manufacture. Name, descriptions, price, special price and dates, weight, URL key, meta fields, status, visibility, websites, categories and stock are always writable. Empty = no extra attributes.

field.label: Max Price Change (%)
field.comment: Refuse a price or special-price change that moves the current value by more than this percentage in one write. Default 50; 0 disables the cap.

field.label: Max Products Per Bulk Write
field.comment: Most SKUs one bulk update may touch. Default 50.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Widget configuration (publishable key, name, color) is fetched automatically from the Horizon gateway using your API key. Enable the assistant for this store in your Horizon dashboard first.

field.label: Knowledge Pages
field.comment: CMS pages the assistant may quote when shoppers ask about delivery times, returns, refunds, payment or how to contact you. Leave empty to auto-detect pages whose title or URL key mentions shipping, delivery, returns, FAQ, customer service, contact, terms or payment. Page content is served as plain text via /horizon/api/v1/store-info.

group.label: Delivery Estimates
group.comment: Lets the assistant tell shoppers roughly when an order will arrive. Dates are computed by the module in the store timezone; the AI only reads them.

field.label: Handling Time (days)
field.comment: Days between an order being placed and being dispatched. Used for orders that haven't shipped yet and for quotes to new shoppers.

field.label: Count Business Days Only
field.comment: Yes = skip Saturdays and Sundays when adding handling and transit days.

field.label: Transit Times
field.comment: Min/max days in transit per carrier (optionally per method code, e.g. express). When a carrier has no row here, the assistant falls back to a time written in the method title, e.g. "Standard Delivery (3-5 days)"; otherwise it gives no date.
